events.title: Patch Notes — v1.0.3801
events.summary: Weapon skillsEvery weapon now has three skills of its own. Z plays to the weapon's strength, X covers its weak spot, and C is its ultimate, on a long wait. Fighting with a weapon fills its mastery as your level fills, and every mastery level is a point to spend on that weapon's skills in the new WEAPONS tab of SKILLS. events.summary: Blade formsNine new weapons to wield instead of the sword, won by clearing deeper and deeper stages. Each one cuts its own way, and each is tuned to match the sword on average. Your skills' copies of the blade take its form too.When you press RUN, you are dealt three of the forms you have won, the one you wield always among them. Clearing stage 100 on a tier opens ten more, and they stay open through ascension.Level Cards: you earn a pick every 10th level.
